display.purpose: Shared major headings; not marketing-scale hero type.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared state feedback and progress updates; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Existing alternate transition token; despite its name this is not a spring.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared lime action, extracted from the shipped button styles.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; background:var(--action); color:var(--action-ink); font-family:var(--body); font-size:15px; font-weight:650; cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--ease),transform var(--ease); } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Quiet secondary action with a forest hairline.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-ghost">Save images for offline use</button>
components.css: .ds-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius:12px; background:transparent; color:var(--text); font-family:var(--body); font-size:15px; font-weight:650; cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--ease),transform var(--ease); } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-ghost:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } } .ds-ghost:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Default forest button for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--body); font-size:15px; font-weight:650; cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--ease),transform var(--ease); } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-secondary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Destructive button
components.description: Outlined danger action, independent of muscle-target rose.
components.css: .ds-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid var(--danger); border-radius:12px; background:transparent; color:var(--danger); font-family:var(--body); font-size:15px; font-weight:650; cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--ease),transform var(--ease); } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-danger:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } } .ds-danger:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-danger:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-danger { transition:none; } }

components.name: Native text field
components.description: Readable native-stack field on raised forest.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Routine name<input class="ds-input" value="Full Body A" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; color:var(--text-2); font-family:var(--body); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-input { display:block; margin-top:7px; width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:11px 12px; background:var(--bg-raised); color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius:10px; font-family:var(--body); font-size:16px; caret-color:var(--action); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-2); opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--action); outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: Pill filter with a visible selected state.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-chip { min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; background:transparent; color:var(--text-2); border:1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--body); font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background:var(--surface-2); border-color:var(--action); color:var(--action); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Forest panel
components.description: Flat tonal container without a decorative shadow.
components.html:
Full Body A

5 exercises · ~45 min
components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); border-radius:14px; padding:16px; font-family:var(--body); } .ds-title { margin:0; font-family:var(--heading); font-size:18px; line-height:1.3; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.015em; } .ds-description { margin:5px 0 0; color:var(--text-2); font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Four-tab navigation
components.description: Today, Plan, Library, Progress; not shown while logging. Preview omits viewport-fixed positioning.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); width:100%; max-width:480px; background:var(--bg); border-top:1px solid var(--hairline); padding:5px 12px env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px); } .ds-tab { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:4px; min-height:62px; padding:8px 4px; background:transparent; border:0; color:var(--text-2); font-family:var(--body); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab svg { width:22px; height:22px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color:var(--action); } @media(hover:hover) { .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--text); } } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Completed set row
components.description: Actual load/reps logging with target context and Done state; advanced set options remain outside the compact row.
components.html: 1Target5–8
components.css: .ds-set-wrap { padding:10px 12px 4px; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-2) 24%,transparent); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--action) 7%,transparent); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--body); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-set { display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px minmax(62px,1fr) minmax(48px,76px) minmax(48px,64px) 44px; gap:6px; align-items:center; } .ds-set-number { text-align:center; font-weight:700; } .ds-guidance { font-size:14px; color:var(--text-2); } .ds-guidance small { display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--action); } .ds-set-input,.ds-done { min-height:44px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-2) 24%,transparent); border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--body); font-size:16px; } .ds-set-input { width:100%; min-width:0; padding:8px 3px; text-align:center; caret-color:var(--action); } .ds-done { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:44px; padding:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-done[aria-pressed='true'] { background:var(--action); color:var(--bg); border-color:var(--action); } .ds-done:hover { border-color:var(--action); } .ds-set-input:focus-visible,.ds-done:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.northStar: Matte forest, chalk, and soft lime
narrative.overview: A quiet, training-first interface: dark matte surfaces, readable chalk text, and soft lime controls put starting and logging ahead of decoration. Compact rows and progressively disclosed guidance keep the task visible without removing useful detail. This names the implemented palette direction, not an invented concept seed or approved artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal forest layers rather than glossy effects.
Locally hosted heading type with native body and control type.
Clear action states and independently encoded anatomy.
Safe-area-aware, single-column layouts and focused logging.

rules.name: The Separate Semantics Rule
rules.body: Keep lime action states independent of rose/lavender muscle targets and the activity scale; always provide text legends or labels.

rules.name: The Matte Layers Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary content with tone and hairlines; reserve shadows for floating elements.

dos: Do use shared forest/chalk/lime tokens across every screen, including dialogs and inspectors.
Do keep logging inputs visible, touch controls comfortable, and fixed-control clearance safe-area-aware.
Do pair anatomical colors with legends and a selectable text alternative.
Do preserve licensed media, attribution, and the local font licence; retain programmatic icon provenance.
donts: Don't use muscle classification colors as brand action colors.
Don't replace real illustrations or saved performance with decorative substitutes.
Don't turn ordinary cards into glowing or heavily shadowed surfaces.
Don't add hosted-font dependencies or navigation tabs to the focused workout route.
